segments.title: WhatsApp texts that VANISH after one read
segments.say: WhatsApp is testing texts that vanish after one read. On iPhone.

segments.title: Like view-once photos
segments.say: You know view-once photos? Now it's coming to text messages.

segments.title: Open it once, it's gone
segments.say: Your friend opens it once, and it's gone.

segments.title: Beta only, for now
segments.say: It's in beta for now, so most people don't have it yet.

segments.title: Source: WABetaInfo
segments.say: That's from WABetaInfo. Not tested by us.
